comments.author: cvdvds
comments.body_html:
Hey, I found a very, very small issue with your mod.

If you apply a kit/loadout in your Gear menu (top left), it equips folded items and puts stuff in them. Something that shouldn’t technically happen, I guess. You can unfold it with one click and everything’s in there and it seems to work absolutely fine.

Calling it an ‘issue’ seems too harsh even. It’s really no big deal but I thought I’d mention it anyway. I found this while testing the ‘BetterLadouts’ mod by cebarks.

Have been using this mod for a long time and have never had any actual issues with it! So while I’m here, let me just also say thank you very much for this great mod!
